home.analyzingDescription: The AI is recognizing cards, position and game situation

guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: Your AI-powered poker training assistant analyzes your game situations and provides instant action recommendations.
guide.whatIsDescription: Poker Coach uses artificial intelligence to analyze screenshots from your online poker games. The AI automatically recognizes:
guide.recommendations: Based on this analysis, you receive a clear recommendation with detailed reasoning.

screenshot.title: Take a Screenshot
screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of your poker game using your system's keyboard shortcut.

upload.title: Upload Image
upload.description: Drag the image to the upload area or click to select. You can also paste directly from clipboard.

result.title: Get Recommendation
result.description: The AI analyzes the image and shows you the optimal action with detailed reasoning within seconds.

guide.extensionDescription: For maximum convenience: The Chrome extension allows you to start an analysis with a single keystroke directly in your browser!
guide.hotkeyDescription: Press this combination during your poker game. The recommendation appears as an overlay directly in the browser.

installSteps.download: Click "Download Extension" and extract the ZIP file.
installSteps.devMode: Enable "Developer mode" in the top right.
installSteps.loadUnpacked: Click "Load unpacked" and select the extracted folder.
installSteps.done: Done! Now use on any poker site.

tipsList.visible: Make sure your cards and the table are clearly visible.
tipsList.readable: The pot size and stack sizes should be readable.
tipsList.actions: Opponent actions (Bet, Raise, etc.) should be recognizable in the screenshot.
tipsList.timing: Take the screenshot before you make your action.
